checks.name: 48_samples_to_odd_columns
checks.detail: 48 tubes -> 48 wells, odd columns only: True

checks.name: step_order
checks.detail: expected per well: beads > isopropanol > sample > remove > ethanol > remove > ethanol > remove > elution > recover

checks.name: fresh_tip_per_sample_no_cross_contact
checks.detail: 48 distinct tips for 48 sample transfers; violations: []

items.evidence: apiLevel 2.13 with metadata; the 250 µL sample transfer uses p1000, and the multichannel moves volumes split into 125, 166.7 or 180 µL strokes, all within 200 µL tip range. Well capacities are respected and the run simulated cleanly.

Check fresh_tip_per_sample_no_cross_contact passed (48 distinct tips, no violations). Each sample gets its own p1000 tip, and the multichannel uses a fresh tip per column for removal, elution and recovery. Reagent tips dispense from top(-2) and never touch sample liquid. Every tip is dropped.

All 16 run-log checks passed. The code follows steps 1–14 in order with the specified volumes and timings (5 min, 4 min, 4 min, 30 s, 90 s). The magnet is disengaged at the end and the 4 °C setpoint comes before any recovery. The only addition is a harmless 5× bead mix in the reservoir.
Checks 48_samples_to_odd_columns and distinct_elution_wells passed. The code pairs the 48 tubes with the wells of columns 1, 3, 5, 7, 9 and 11, and each tube is moved by its own p1000 tip.

Checks binding_volumes_40_250_250, mix_5x_after_sample, incubation_5min_before_magnet, magnet_4min_before_first_removal and magnet_engaged_for_all_removals all passed. The code does beads, then isopropanol, then sample, then p1000.mix(5), then delay 5 min, engage, delay 4 min, then removal of 540 µL.

Checks two_500ul_ethanol_washes and air_dry_4min passed. Each wash adds 500 µL and removes it with the magnet engaged, then a 4 min delay runs with the magnet still on, and mag_mod.disengage() follows before elution.

Checks elution_100ul, elution_off_magnet_then_90s_on, recover_70_100ul_one_well_each and elution_plate_4C_before_recovery passed. The code adds 100 µL and mixes with the magnet off, waits 30 s, engages and waits 90 s, then moves 80 µL to a distinct well of the 4 °C plate.

judge.summary: The protocol passed the simulator and all 16 measured run-log checks. It follows the task steps in order, with correct volumes, timings, magnet states, fresh tips and distinct elution wells. I found no deviation, so every item scores 1.
